Select molecule ChEMBL identifier as molecule_chembl_id, preferred name as molecule_name, max phase as max_phase, molecule type as molecule_type, and canonical SMILES as canonical_smiles from the document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4257575. Left join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES, allowing nulls. Sort by molecule ChEMBL identifier ascending.
